premises.prerequisite_A: The supplied scalar velocity field defines, for every arbitrary nearby endpoint z at time t, the unique local ODE solution dz(s)/ds=v(z(s),s) ending at that endpoint. Define the field u(z,r,t) as the integral of v along that backward solution divided by t-r for r<t, with its continuous extension at r=t. The integral equals endpoint displacement. In the square-root flow, use only endpoints whose backward solution stays strictly positive with sqrt(z)+(r-t)>0; no other off-trajectory extension of u is allowed.
premises.prerequisite_B: The product rule and chain rule hold. For a differentiable field f(z,r,t), its derivative along dz/dt=v and dr/dt=rho is partial_t f + v*partial_z f + rho*partial_r f. Holding the endpoint state fixed defines partial_t; it does not generally define the trajectory derivative.

target.question: Derive the local relation for average velocity at fixed lower time from the integral definition, then evaluate its right-hand side using the actual derivative along the supplied trajectory and lower-time rate. Return the average, instantaneous endpoint velocity, partial derivative with respect to upper time holding z and r fixed, partial derivative with respect to endpoint state, actual total derivative, the fixed-lower relation's right-hand side, whether that right-hand side equals the average, displacement, and lower endpoint. If the stated positive-branch flow and trajectory are incompatible, return INAPPLICABLE with reason positive_branch_required. Use the continuous extension at r=t.
target.response_format: Return exactly one JSON object. VALID has keys status, average_velocity, instantaneous_velocity, partial_time, partial_state, total_derivative, identity_rhs, identity_holds, displacement, endpoint_r. All numeric fields are integers or exact rational strings; identity_holds is a boolean. INAPPLICABLE has exactly status and reason. No prose or extra keys.

condition_text.minimal_bridge: Differentiate the interval-scaled average along the trajectory; keep the lower time fixed when deriving the fixed-lower relation.
condition_text.alternate_bridge: Replace the velocity integral by endpoint displacement, then apply the quotient rule along the trajectory.
condition_text.wrong_bridge: Hold the endpoint state fixed and use only the partial time derivative as the trajectory derivative.
condition_text.irrelevant: A paragraph can contain several sentences, and a sentence can contain several words.
